sections.content_text: Section 43 - Computation of special deductions in case of non-maintenance of Books of Accounts (1) If it appears that,— (a) the taxpayer does not follow a regular accounting system; (b) the taxpayer applies any method on the basis of which it appears to the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes that it is not possible to arrive at a conclusion as to the income of the taxpayer; (c) the taxpayer has failed to maintain records of accounts or transactions; or (d) the accounts or records of transactions maintained by the taxpayer are not verifiable, notwithstanding anything contained in any other section, 60% (sixty percent) of the market value of the agricultural produce so produced shall be treated as allowable expenditure.
